title: Benchmark completes 2026 IOSCO audit with Type 2 assurance
author: Daisy Jennings-Gray, Matthew Bird
text: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence Limited (“Benchmark”) is delighted to announce the successful completion of an independent assurance engagement of its policies, processes and controls implemented to adhere to the IOSCO Principles for Price Reporting Agencies (“PRA”) for the sixth consecutive year.The assurance engagement was conducted by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (“PwC”).Benchmark was again subject to reasonable assurance opinion by PwC across the 12 month period ending 30 September 2026 (sometimes referred to as Type 2 assurance) – the highest level of assurance available – over its activities for price grades under its Lithium, Nickel, Cobalt and Flake Graphite and Uncoated Spherical Graphite, Synthetic Graphite, Anode, Cathode, Black Mass and Rare Earths Price Assessments.This engagement assures whether, throughout this period, Benchmark adhered to its stated methodology and procedures, as required by the IOSCO Principles using its unique market-specific price assessment methodologies.This positions Benchmark as the leading price provider across global strategic supply chains such as energy and defence, ensuring prices are assessed to the highest standards.Benchmark’s transparency in maintaining this highest level of external assurance with a leading audit firm demonstrates the company’s founding principle to provide the most robust and reliable price data across strategic supply chains for its subscribers.A copy of the report can be requested here.Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices at Benchmark said:“Ongoing volatility across strategic supply chains has heightened awareness of price risk mitigation, with a particular focus on emerging trade flows outside of China in energy and defence sectors.“The credibility of accurate and reliable price information is more critical than ever, and Benchmark is positioned to deliver this data underpinned by another successful audit.“With increased scrutiny over the price benchmarks that players across industry and government rely on, there is a heightened requirement for trusted data and transparent methodologies, which the IOSCO Principles assure.“Our global team are experts in what they do, and this assurance showcases their commitment to reliability and consistency.”Adam Megginson, Principal Analyst, Benchmark said: “It is great to see Benchmark’s market-leading Price Assessments have once again passed the strict scrutiny of the Type 2 IOSCO price reporting assurance process. Another successful report demonstrates the importance of the hard work and precision that goes into each of our price grades. It reinforces the trust the industry puts into Benchmark’s data to bring greater transparency to volatile markets.”Which Benchmark prices were included within the scope of the engagement?Reasonable
